steps.title: Create a free account
steps.description: Open GitHub's sign-up page and enter your email, a password and a username. The free plan is enough.

pointer.where: github.com/signup, after your email, password and username

steps.title: Verify your email
steps.description: GitHub emails you a code. Type it into the sign-up page to finish creating your account.

pointer.where: the sign-up page, using the code from GitHub's email

steps.title: Turn on two-factor sign-in
steps.description: Open your profile picture, then Settings, then Password and authentication. Use an authenticator app or a passkey.

steps.title: Keep your recovery codes private
steps.description: Download the recovery codes and keep them somewhere safe. Never share them, not even with MakeItOurs support.

steps.title: Connect GitHub in MakeItOurs
steps.description: Press Connect GitHub in the app. Type the one-time code it shows into GitHub's device page, then authorize MakeItOurs.

pointer.where: github.com/login/device, after you type the app's code

steps.title: Install the MakeItOurs App
steps.description: When MakeItOurs asks, open the MakeItOurs App on GitHub and choose your account.

pointer.where: the MakeItOurs App page on GitHub

link.label: Open the MakeItOurs App on GitHub

steps.title: Choose your repositories
steps.description: Pick Only select repositories and choose your MakeItOurs projects. You can change this list or uninstall the app at any time.

pointer.where: the install page, before you press Install

steps.title: You're connected
steps.description: Back in MakeItOurs, your projects appear. From here on the app saves and builds through GitHub for you.
